verdictEs: Aim Lab si recién empiezas con aim training: es free, corre en Steam, Epic y consolas, y tiene mejor onboarding con presets calibrados a Valorant. KovaaK's cuando ya tienes base (50-100 horas) y quieres profundidad: librería community-made enorme, benchmarks Voltaic y routines de pros, a cambio de ~$10 one-time y solo en Windows.
verdictEn: Aim Lab if you're just starting with aim training: it's free, runs on Steam, Epic, and consoles, and has friendlier onboarding with Valorant-calibrated presets. KovaaK's once you have a base (50-100 hours) and want depth: a huge community-made library, Voltaic benchmarks, and pro-designed routines, in exchange for a ~$10 one-time price and Windows-only support.
